subject.title: fix(moonshot): kimi search 401 with china-region api keys

question: Should this docs/diagnostic PR close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94979, or should the closing reference be removed until the reporter's exact Windows service path is proven fixed?
rationale: The patch improves the supported configuration path and 401 guidance, but it does not change routing and the linked issue only shows a bare webSearch API key without the full redacted config or failing host.

options.title: Remove the closing reference
options.body: Merge the helpful docs/error copy while keeping the linked issue open for reporter confirmation or a narrower runtime fix if needed.

options.title: Accept issue closure
options.body: Keep the closing reference if a maintainer decides the existing configuration path plus clearer diagnostics is enough to resolve the report.

options.title: Pause for exact live proof
options.body: Wait for a Windows service or reporter-config reproduction before merging if closure confidence is required before landing.

recommendation.title: Remove the closing reference
recommendation.body: Merge the helpful docs/error copy while keeping the linked issue open for reporter confirmation or a narrower runtime fix if needed.
